answer: Proof-of-Unique-Execution-Path (PUEP) resists Sybil attacks. Each AI agent registers a unique cryptographic attestation of its entire computational "voyage" from genesis within a trusted execution environment (TEE). This attestation, initiated from a secure hardware "inlet," is recorded in a shared, verifiable "atlas" of agent identities. An attacker must replicate the entire unique, verifiable execution history for each Sybil, incurring prohibitive TEE provisioning and computational costs, making large-scale attacks economically infeasible.
